comment: DelayOS Store > 게임. One game per line. Fields: id, name (official), name_ko (Korean name shown first), pub (publisher), cats (category ids below), platform = native (runs on DelayOS: native Linux build, Steam Proton or Flatpak) | windows (needs the real Windows of this PC: delay-winboot, docs/windows-switch.md) | unsupported (neither works), verify = true when the Linux status is uncertain or changes often (the Store shows '확인 필요'), free, how = how DelayOS installs/starts it: {type: steam, appid} | {type: flatpak, ref} | {type: lutris, service} | {type: heroic, store} | {type: winboot, id = id in /usr/share/delayos/winboot/games.json, launcher, appid?} | {type: winmanual, service, page = official site; the user installs it in Windows and registers it with 'Windows 게임 추가'}, ac = anti-cheat, note (Korean, honest caveats), kw = extra search words (Korean nicknames), image = Steam's public header image URL, loaded at run time (no third-party artwork is shipped; offline or missing -> generic genre tile), source = where the status was checked.

sources.AWACY: https://areweanticheatyet.com (games.json of github.com/AreWeAntiCheatYet/AreWeAntiCheatYet, fetched 2026-11-27): Supported/Running = works on Linux, Broken/Denied = does not
sources.SteamKR: https://store.steampowered.com/api/appdetails?appids=<appid>&cc=kr&l=koreana (fetched 2026-11-27): app id, name, Linux build flag, availability in the Korean Steam store
sources.knowledge: no primary source fetched; marked verify when it matters
